change.commits: PR branch commits of synth#1537 (2026-10-14) through synth#1621 (2026-10-29), among others

net.note: PR branch commits were authored by a stray local git identity (name and email a single letter), so GitHub reports signature state NO_USER: unverified. The PRs squash-merge and GitHub signs the squash commit, so main shows only verified commits and no main-side check sees the branch identity. Verified on 2026-10-29 over the 60 most recently updated synth PRs: every unverified commit was of this identity.

why.classifier: gate checks the wrong object: signing is enforced on main's squash commit, not on what was authored

countermeasure.gate: none yet. Candidates: a PR check that every commit is verified and authored by an expected identity; fix the worktree identity at the source

method:
recorded per unit and never mixed silently:
  escape (post-merge):
    main-red    a push/merge_group GitHub Actions suite on the unit's sha concluded
                FAILURE/TIMED_OUT/STARTUP_FAILURE and the previous run of the same
                workflow on first-parent main was not red (a red streak is charged
                to the commit that started it; path-filtered commits are skipped)
    revert      a later unit says "This reverts commit <sha>" or is titled
                Revert "<this unit's subject>"
    hotfix-ref  a later fix:/revert unit, within 14 days, references this unit's
                PR number (#N). Heuristic: a mention is not proof of causation
    merge-guard a "merge-guard: unchecked change on main (<sha12>)" issue
    ledger      a docs/incidents/ledger.yaml entry of kind escape names this merge
                (a manually found escape, e.g. a harness defect fixed later)
  catch (pre-merge):
    pr-red      a PR commit before the head had a FAILURE/ERROR status rollup and
                the head's rollup is SUCCESS (red that later went green). Rollup
                level, so it includes non-required checks
    mq-ejected  the PR was removed from the merge queue with reason failed_checks
  flags (nets, not incidents):
    merged-before-ci   a pull_request Actions suite on the head was still running
                       at mergedAt
    merged-red-head    the head's status rollup is FAILURE/ERROR yet it merged
    no-pr              pushed to main without a PR

baseline.note: Weak baseline. Pre-agent = first-parent merges before the repo's first agent marker. Spans: rules_wasm_component 2025-07-06 to 2025-11-14 (230 merges); mcp 2025-07-01 to 2026-02-20 (44 merges); rules_rocq_rust 2026-01-11 to 2026-02-20 (44 merges). Confounders: a different project phase (early, small changes), fewer repos, often no PRs and no merge queue, CI that may not have existed yet (no CI means no main-red signal, so the pre-agent escape rate is biased low), and no marker does not mean no AI. Signals limited to main-red, revert, hotfix-ref, pr-red in both eras.
excluded: sigil: pre-agent history is the imported upstream project (another author), not this org's process
